# ResumeBuddy & AI Resume Builder

> Open source, privacy-focused AI Resume Builder and Developer Portfolio Platform.

ResumeBuddy enables engineers and professionals to parse resumes, analyze ATS compatibility, match target job descriptions, and generate responsive, interactive developer portfolio websites.

## Core Capabilities

- **AI Resume Builder & Parser**: Upload existing resumes in PDF or DOCX formats, parse experience and skills deterministically, and export optimized documents.
- **ATS Checker & Keyword Matcher**: Score resumes against target job descriptions with keyword and skill gap analysis.
- **Developer Portfolio Generator**: Generate interactive live portfolio websites with themes including Kinetic Editorial, Spotlight, Poster, and One-Page Résumé.
- **Export Formats**: Deterministic PDF rendering and Word DOCX generation.

- [Resume Templates](https://ai-resume-builder-client-three.vercel.app/resumes)
- [API Documentation](https://ai-resume-builder-client-three.vercel.app/api)

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend**: React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, GSAP, Three.js, Lucide Icons, Vite
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express, MongoDB Mongoose, Cloudinary, Gemini AI
